From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@cardiotech.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CardioTech: VPC + air-gapped options — evidence & topology next steps

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call highlights (very brief)
- CardioTech needs a private deployment with strict network isolation and an option to air-gap for regulatory demos.
- Primary compliance concerns: SOC 2 (in progress), HIPAA applicability for PHI pipelines, and GDPR cross-border controls for EU patient data.
- Expected timeline: pilot environment in ~8–12 weeks; procurement and legal timelines TBD.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) We’ll share a one-page SOC 2 snapshot and a first-pass deployment topology (attached). Action: Vivek — send SOC2 snapshot + topology v1.
2) CardioTech to confirm whether production workload will carry PHI and whether EU datasets will be processed. Action: Alice — confirm PHI / EU scope.
3) We’ll initiate the vendor security questionnaire (we’ve attached a simple XLS to capture answers). Action: Rishi — own questionnaire intake + evidence mapping.
4) Follow-up call to review topology and questionnaire answers (30 min). Proposed window: next Tue/Wed. Action: Lauren — coordinate calendar.

Attachments I will send: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, proposed-topology-v1.png, vendor-questionnaire-cardiotech.xlsx

If that matches your view, we’ll push the attachments now and Rishi will loop in our security engineer for any deep-dive.

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (650) 555-0127

From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@cardiotech.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: CardioTech Security Team <security@cardiotech.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CardioTech: VPC + air-gapped options — evidence & topology next steps

Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with our internal notes. A few clarifications: 

- We will likely process PHI in the pilot (de-identified where possible) — compliance will confirm but plan for HIPAA path.
- EU data: for now, US-only but potential EU expansion in Q4.
- Questionnaire: can you provide guidance on expected evidence for the SOC 2 snapshot? Our security lead wants to know which artifacts you typically provide versus what we must produce.

Calendar: Tue/Wed next week looks good for a 30-minute call — I’ll let Lauren coordinate.

Appreciate the attachments in advance.

—Alice
Director of Product | CardioTech AI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CardioTech: VPC + air-gapped options — evidence & topology next steps

Vivek / Lauren —

I’ll own the vendor questionnaire intake. Plan:
- I’ll populate the attached vendor-questionnaire-cardiotech.xlsx with the answers we can provide from Redwood (SOC 2 status, encryption-at-rest keys, KMS integrations, network ACL examples, audit-log retention windows).
- For evidence we can supply right away: SOC 2 summary (controls in-scope), SSAE-18 letter (redacted), KMS integration notes, network isolation diagram (attachment).
- For customer-specific artifacts (e.g., proof of encrypted egress in their environment) we’ll list what CardioTech needs to provide — I’ll make that explicit in the XLS.

Next actions from me (over the next 48 hours):
1) Fill out questionnaire draft and mark required evidence columns.
2) Attach the SOC 2 snapshot and the topology PNG to the XLS package.
3) Recommend a 30-min security deep-dive if CardioTech wants to review controls line-by-line (optional).

I’m also going to loop in our security engineer (internal) if we need to answer technical controls questions; will keep Alice’s security team as primary external contact.

-Rishi
Principal Security PM | Redwood Inference

- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (one-page snapshot with in-scope controls & date of last audit)
- proposed-topology-v1.png (first-pass private VPC / optional air-gap mode; annotated)

Quick notes on SOC 2 artifacts we provide vs. items for you: 
- Redwood provides: SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), control descriptions, KMS/HSM integration documentation, audit-log retention policy excerpts, and sample runbooks for incident response.
- CardioTech to provide: any customer-specific network ACLs, network owner contact for on-prem handoff, and where PHI will be ingested so we can map dataflow.

Lauren — can you propose Tue 10:00–11:00 or Wed 09:00–10:00 PT for the follow-up? Alice indicated Tue/Wed looked good.

Alice — once you confirm PHI + EU scope and give us a preferred slot, Rishi and I will be on the call to walk through the topology and evidence asks.

Best,

Vivek
